Yummy pho
Nov 2022 • Friends
Very typical Vietnamese cuisine and if you like pho, this is probably one of the best in district 1. The soup is really nice and refreshing especially with the added lime onto the soup. The chicken is exceptionally yummy as this is a free range chicken and not the typical farming chicken. Meat is rather chewy but has good taste of chicken! The place is rather dirty and warm. Sitting at lower stool and enjoy the traditional style of Vietnamese eating . Ordered the fried spring roll and so far won’t go too wrong ! Be careful of the coffee that’s rather strong and don’t stir too much of the condensed milk… it can be rather too sweet to drink.

So Good!
Apr 2017
Pho Ha was recommended to us by a drunk Aussie expat at a nearby bar. So we were a bit dubious, but so pleasantly surprised. It's just a bunch of plastic tables set up on the pavement, but don't be put off by this. They're obviously set up for tourists with English menus (the English is iffy, but you'll figure it out), but when a place is packed with locals at 2 am, you know you've got something good.

Our food -- we ordered pho, naturally, and a couple noodle dishes -- came quickly and was gloriously delicious. Everything was simple, lovely and (to the best of my knowledge) authentic. The street outside seems to be a hangout for taxi drivers waiting for their next fare, so it was easy to get back to our hotel, even in the middle of the night. 

Highly, highly recommended.
